carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the lateral flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge, extending from the branchial region towards the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance circular spots, primarily concentrated on the visible anterior and middle portions of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant V-shaped notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicating potential previous physical trauma or amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of micro-spots (small high-luminance pixel clusters) compared to the primary lateral flank region.
